Checks.description:
Completeness checks a window must pass before its checkpoint moves, besides those every
recipe gets: each call succeeded, each listing reached its stop condition, each cursor was
followed and each listed item got its detail call.

page_numbers.description:
Page numbers run from ``first`` without a gap or a repeat, and end at ``total_pages``
when the response states it. Needs page paging with ``number``.
page_numbers.title: Page Numbers

reply_counts.description:
The ``items`` a detail call returns, less the item itself with ``includes_root``, are as
many as the ``reply_count`` of the listed item. Needs ``list.item.reply_count`` and
``detail.items``. A server whose count includes the item (``3 messages``) leaves
``includes_root`` out, so both sides count it.
reply_counts.title: Reply Counts

totals.description: The items of a listing equal the ``total`` its responses state. Needs ``total``.
totals.title: Totals

Checks.title: Checks

CursorPaging.description: The response names the next page by a cursor, which the next call sends back.

argument.description: The argument that carries the cursor; left out of the first call.
argument.title: Argument

next.description: Where the next cursor is. Missing, null or empty: the last page.
next.title: Next

has_more.description:
Where the response says whether more pages follow. When set, a page that says no is the
last, and a page that says yes without a cursor fails the run's completeness.
has_more.title: Has More

max_pages.description: Pages one listing may take; a listing that reaches it is incomplete.
max_pages.title: Max Pages

CursorPaging.title: CursorPaging

DetailCall.description: The call made for each listed item: the replies of a thread, the body of a meeting.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments; they name the item with ``{item.id}`` or another ``{item.NAME}``.
arguments.title: Arguments

decode.description: How the result is read: json, structured or text.
decode.title: Decode

when.description: For which items: every item, or those whose ``reply_count`` is above zero.
when.title: When

items.description:
Where the replies are, to count them (``checks.reply_counts``): a path with ``*``, or a
pattern that matches each reply. Counted over every page of the detail call.
items.title: Items

includes_root.description: Whether ``items`` holds the item itself besides its replies; it is then not counted.
includes_root.title: Includes Root

paging.description: How the detail call pages, if it does; one call by default.
paging.title: Paging

DetailCall.title: DetailCall

ListCall.description: The call that lists a stream's items in a window, page by page.

decode.description: How the result is read: json, structured or text.
decode.title: Decode

items.description: Where the items are: a path with ``*``, or a pattern that matches each item.
items.title: Items

order.description:
The order of the items. With ``newest_first`` a listing stops after the first page that
reaches past the window's start; with ``oldest_first``, after one that reaches its end.
``any``: every page is read.
order.title: Order

paging.description: How the next page is asked for and when the listing ends.
paging.title: Paging

ListCall.title: ListCall

ListItem.description:
Where the values of one listed item are, relative to the item (``@`` paths, or patterns
over the item's text).

id.description: The item's id at the server: what a detail call asks for.
id.title: Id

timestamp.description: The item's time, read in ``timestamp_format``. Needed for an ordered listing.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

timestamp_format.description: rfc3339, unix, unix_ms, or a strptime pattern (%Y %m %d %H %M %S %f %z).
timestamp_format.title: Timestamp Format

timezone.description: The IANA zone of a timestamp that carries none; UTC when not set.
timezone.title: Timezone

reply_count.description: The number of replies the listing announces for the item.
reply_count.title: Reply Count

fields.description: Other values a detail call needs, by name: ``{item.NAME}`` in its arguments.
fields.title: Fields

ListItem.title: ListItem

NoPaging.description: One call returns the whole listing.
NoPaging.title: NoPaging

OffsetPaging.description: The next call skips the items seen so far.

argument.description: The argument that carries the number of items to skip.
argument.title: Argument

start.description: The offset of the first item: 0 or 1.
start.title: Start

size_argument.description: The argument that carries the page size; needs ``size``.
size_argument.title: Size Argument

size.description: Items per page. A page with fewer is the last.
size.title: Size

total.description: Where the response states the number of items of the listing; the listing ends there.
total.title: Total

has_more.description: Where the response says whether more pages follow.
has_more.title: Has More

OffsetPaging.title: OffsetPaging

PagePaging.description: Pages are numbered; the next call asks for the next number.

argument.description: The argument that carries the page number.
argument.title: Argument

first.description: The number of the first page: 1 or 0.
first.title: First

size_argument.description: The argument that carries the page size; needs ``size``.
size_argument.title: Size Argument

size.description: Items per page. A page with fewer is the last.
size.title: Size

number.description: Where the response states its page number (for ``checks.page_numbers``).
number.title: Number

total_pages.description: Where the response states the number of pages. The page with that number is the last.
total_pages.title: Total Pages

total.description: Where the response states the number of items of the listing (for ``checks.totals``).
total.title: Total

has_more.description: Where the response says whether more pages follow.
has_more.title: Has More

PagePaging.title: PagePaging

Parser.description: The deterministic parser that turns the raw responses of a window into records.

name.description: A parser registered in the service, such as ``hearth.thread``.
name.title: Name

options.description: Settings the parser reads, such as a URL pattern for records; it checks them.
options.title: Options

Parser.title: Parser

Rate.description: The budget of calls to the server.

calls_per_minute.description: At most this many calls in any minute.
calls_per_minute.title: Calls Per Minute

max_calls.description: Calls one run may make; a run that reaches it is incomplete.
max_calls.title: Max Calls

timeout.description: How long one call may take.
timeout.title: Timeout

Rate.title: Rate

Server.description:
The MCP server the recipe was written for. A server that reports another name or version
has drifted: the executor stops on another name and warns on another version.

name.description: The name the server reports when a session starts (``serverInfo.name``).
name.title: Name

versions.description:
Versions (``serverInfo.version``) the recipe was checked against; ``*`` matches any
characters, as in ``1.4.*``. Empty: any version.
versions.title: Versions

Server.title: Server

Stream.description: What one stream of a source is and what its records become.

kind.description: The kind of record the parser makes of the stream's items.
kind.title: Kind

key_description.description:
What a stream key is, for the person who configures a source: "a channel id, such as
C0001", "a mailbox search query".
key_description.title: Key Description

key_pattern.description: A regular expression a stream key must match in full.
key_pattern.title: Key Pattern

snapshot.description:
Whether a complete listing of a window holds every live item of the window, so an item
left out has been deleted at the source (an ingest snapshot).
snapshot.title: Snapshot

Stream.title: Stream

Window.description:
How the planner cuts a stream's history into windows ``[from, to)``. A source may set its
own values; these are the defaults for the server.

overlap.description: How far behind the checkpoint a window starts, to catch late replies and edits.
overlap.title: Overlap

initial.description: How much recent history the first sync of a stream loads.
initial.title: Initial

backfill.description:
How much older history each later run loads, until the source's retention start. Left
out: no history beyond the initial window.
backfill.title: Backfill

max_span.description: The longest window one listing covers; a longer window is split. Left out: no limit.
max_span.title: Max Span

Window.title: Window

description: How to sync one MCP server: a declarative file per server (docs/recipes.md).

format.description: The version of the recipe format: 1.
format.title: Format

name.description: The recipe's name: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_'.
name.title: Name

detail.description: The call per listed item, if the listing alone does not hold what the parser needs.

title: Memini MCP recipe
